svg.aria-label: The Agentinel session guard follows one Claude Code session. It records that a fetched web page is untrusted input and fingerprints the values read from .env, lets an ordinary git push through, and asks only when a curl call carries a value read from .env after untrusted input.

and this call to Bash curl carries data

text.font-family: OFSans, 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: , so a prompt injection could be leaking it.
Approve only if you expected this.

text.font-family: OFSans, 'Space Grotesk', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: It can only add a prompt, and it fails open, so your own permission rules still apply.
